thread:
Lina (PM): Quick convo: drafting a safeguarded rollout pattern for the next model change. Goal: support per-tenant holdbacks, small experiment cohorts, automated latency/cost fallbacks, and clear sales-approved opt-outs. Posting a concise plan + open questions.

Omar (SRE): Love the focus. Two operational rules up front: 1) start at <=0.1% global traffic or 1 region localized at 0.5% depending on risk; 2) always run a shadow copy for 24h ingesting traffic but not affecting billing/metrics used for routing.

Jia (Eng): Implementation notes: add a compatibility label on model assets: compat:[full|quant|lite]. Fallback order = quant -> lite -> previous stable. That lets us auto-degrade before full rollback. Also we should tag weight hashes so routing can detect mismatches.

Priya (CS): Customers: enterprise tenants expect explicit opt-out and an audit trail. We need a per-tenant flag + email notification template. Legal wants a configurable notice window (default 14 days) and opt-out URL.

Lina (PM): Proposed rollout phases:
- Phase 0: internal perf & semantic shadow (smoke tests + synthetic prompts)
- Phase 1: micro-canary (0.1% global OR 1% of a single non-critical region) for 2 windows of 20m
- Phase 2: regional ramp (2% -> 10% -> 40%) with 30m windows and automated checks
- Phase 3: global ramp to 100% after 24h stable.
Q: Should we allow a shorter path for non-SLA models?

Omar (SRE): We can, but only if the model is pre-approved and telemetry passes an extended staging soak. Also require elevated autoscaling buffer for each ramp step. Default circuit-break: if p95 > baseline_p95 + 30% for 10m OR errors > baseline_error + 0.8pp for 5m -> trigger fallback.

Jia (Eng): For flags I suggest naming: featroll/<model-name>/v<semver>/<env>/<scope> where scope=global|region|tenant. Separate keys: featroll/<model>/holdback/<tenant-id>. CLI examples:
```
# enable micro-canary in ap-south
redwood rollout apply --flag featroll/zephyr/v1.2.0/prod/ap-south --pct 1
# set tenant holdback
redwood flags set --tenant T-451 featroll/zephyr/holdback=true
```

Priya (CS): Also need a customer-facing timeline snippet for sales: "We will schedule your opt-out window upon agreement; by default changes roll out 14 days after notification unless you opt out." Keep wording tight.

Lina (PM): Telemetry contract minimal set: request_count, p50/p95/p99 latency, http_5xx_rate, model_token_cost, semantic_regression_score. Semantic checks: run 200 sampled golden prompts every 10m and compute delta; signal threshold = median delta > 0.02 (manual review).

Omar (SRE): Add cost safety: token_cost change > 25% triggers an alert and moves model into "throttleback" (limit RPS to baseline RPS) while ops investigates. Also include token-quota guard per-tenant to avoid single-tenant cost spikes.

Jia (Eng): A/B/Experiment notes: use Bayesian estimation for small cohorts. Decision rules: latency or cost violations -> automatic rollback; semantic quality regressions -> flag for manual review and require at least 2 reviewers to approve rollback. Stat-sig window default = 24h for quality metrics.

Priya (CS): Contract handling: enterprise SKUs default to manual approve. Sales can opt customers into auto-updates per contract. We should add a checkbox in the onboarding flow.

Lina (PM): Runbook snippet for fallback:
1) deploy-bot flips route to quant variant (if available) and creates incident
2) if metrics still bad after 10m, flip to previous stable and notify on-call + #incidents
3) open a postmortem if >=15min total outage or >0.5pp customer error impact

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: featroll/zephyr/v1.2.0 -> region=ap-south-1, initial=0.5% traffic, windows=20m x2, shadow=true. Observability hooks: canary-dashboard + sampled-evals.

Omar (SRE): One more ask: add an automated "cooldown" mechanism to prevent oscillation (no >2 rollbacks in 1h). And ensure the routing layer respects tenant holdbacks even if global flag flips.

Jia (Eng): We'll add holdback precedence in the routing logic (tenant-level overrides region/global). Also will expose an API to list affected tenants before a rollout.

Lina (PM): Thanks 1. Action items: Jia/Omar to produce exact thresholds and routing spec by EOD; Priya to draft opt-out email and onboarding checkbox; I'll update the roadmap entry and publish the rollout checklist. Any other blockers?

Priya (CS): None from my side. Need the opt-out link before I email customers.

Omar (SRE): No blockers, will sync with infra to reserve buffer.

Lina (PM): Great — closing the thread. We will attach the checklist to the release PR. :white_check_mark:
